caption:
Your ear will pick "depicts." It's wrong.

A that-clause can't hold the main subject. Skip it, then match: murals depict.

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: Your ear will pick depicts. It's wrong. Skip the that-clause: the murals depict.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: Subject-Verb Agreement With That Clauses
youtube.description: How to find the subject when a relative clause sits between it and the verb. SAT-style practice question (original).
